Name: Elle's Cat Replacements
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dL1CbFE.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

- 51 cat skins to choose from
- Ability to configure a different skin for the 3 cat textures
- Optional collars in 20 colors which can be different for each of the 3 cats
- Replacement of the cat head icons in the menu (which change based on your skin choices)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to change your cats/collars to the textures/colors you prefer. Collars or skins are disabled with the value "[font=Courier New]False[/font]"
[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new retexture!


Each pair of options in the config.json refers to the 3 vanilla cat textures available when you create a character or use the Shrine of Illusions. They replace the following:

Cat 1:
 [img]https://i.imgur.com/65CALZF.png[/img]

Cat 2:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SdmTsic.png[/img]

Cat 3:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/heyJvOr.png[/img]

The collar options are set to "False" by default. To enable them, replace "False" with the color you want! All texture replacements are enabled by default, but can also be disabled with the value "False" to keep any of the vanilla cats you want. Names for each cat texture and collar color can be found in the images in the included References folder.

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.﻿

[b][color=#e69138]Optional[/color][/b]: I have also included an optional folder of skins for use with the [color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n Skin[/url] [/color]mod! This will let you use more variants of cats and dogs on your farm. [b][color=#ff0000]Note[/color] that if you use A&S, you should only use the skins, not the main download.[/b]

To use, extract the skins folder into Adopt 'n Skin's assets folder and merge it. I have included all skins shown here; simply delete the ones you don't want to use! They are named Dog_1 through Dog_101, so if you already have skins in your folder you want to keep, you will need to do some renaming.

This mod is also compatible with the [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7407]Cats and Dogs[/url]﻿[/u] mod if you want to have more pets on your farm.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿

1.1.0 - Updated for SDV v1.4, now allows 3 separate skin choices for the 3 cat textures
         - Added optional collars in 20 colors (enabled per texture)
         - Added a new cat skin called Vanilla, uses vanilla cat colors
1.0.1 - Added cat heads to the Cursors tilesheet so your cat shows up in the menu. (Optional, enabled by default)
